header.title: Breadcrumbs
header.subtitle: A navigation trail that shows the current page's position in the route hierarchy. Derives its crumbs automatically from the pathname via src/lib/route-info.ts, or accepts a controlled crumbs prop for dynamic segments and custom labels.

anatomy.title: Anatomy
anatomy.description: A nav element containing a list of Crumb items separated by ChevronRight icons. All crumbs except the last are rendered as links; the last crumb is a bold span with no link.

auto.title: Auto-derived (default)
auto.description: With no props, Breadcrumbs reads the current pathname and derives the crumb chain from src/lib/route-info.ts. Navigate to any page — the breadcrumbs at the top of this page are the real component in action.

controlled.title: Controlled mode
controlled.description: Pass a crumbs array to override auto-derivation. Use this for dynamic segments where you have a meaningful label to show instead of the raw URL slug.

singleSource.title: Single source of truth
singleSource.description: Auto-derivation reads sidebar.config.ts via src/lib/route-info.ts. When you add a new route to the sidebar config, both the topbar title and the breadcrumbs update automatically — no separate dictionaries to keep in sync.

props.title: Props
props.description: crumbs is the only prop. When omitted, the component auto-derives from the pathname.

crumbProps.title: Crumb
crumbProps.description: Each object in the crumbs array describes one step in the trail.

anatomy.nav: nav element — the accessible landmark container for the trail
anatomy.crumbs: Array of Crumb items — rendered as links (except the last) separated by chevrons
anatomy.chevron: ChevronRight icon — visual separator between crumbs
anatomy.lastCrumb: The current page crumb — rendered as a bold span with no link (not navigable)

single.title: 1 level (returns null)
single.description: When the chain has only one crumb (Dashboard), the component returns null and renders nothing. This is the behavior on the root / page.

two.title: 2 levels
two.description: Dashboard and a direct child — the most common pattern.

three.title: 3 levels with virtual group
three.description: Dashboard, the UI section, a non-linkable group label, and the leaf page.

dynamic.title: Dynamic segment
dynamic.description: Use controlled mode when you have a meaningful label for a dynamic URL segment instead of the raw ID.

custom.title: Custom path
custom.description: Any sequence of crumbs can be passed — the component does not validate against the sidebar config in controlled mode.

props.crumbs: Optional array of Crumb objects. When provided, used directly instead of auto-derivation.

crumbProps.label: Human-readable text shown in the trail.
crumbProps.href: Navigation target. Pass null to render as a non-clickable span (useful for virtual group labels).
